The child attends daycare where another child was reported to have similar lesions recently. Patient's brother had chickenpox one month ago. Immunizations are up-to-date.

Symptoms.Primary_Symptom: Skin-colored, nontender, pearly papules with central umbilication on the abdomen and extremities

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Previously healthy, up-to-date immunizations, no significant illnesses.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Attends daycare three times per week.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: No fever, rash in other locations, itching, or systemic symptoms.

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the pediatric patient presenting with multiple skin lesions.

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Doctor: Hello, I’m your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: My mom says I have several small, skin-colored bumps on my belly that don’t hurt or itch, and I’ve also got a few on my arms and legs. They’re not making me feel sick.
Do any of the bumps have a tiny dimple or white center in the middle of them?
Patient: Yes, some of the bumps have a tiny dimple in the middle, like a little white center, and they don’t hurt or itch.
How long have these bumps been present, and have they been spreading or multiplying over time?
Patient: They’ve been there for about a week, and my mom says they’ve been slowly increasing in number a little since we first noticed them.
Does the child have a history of eczema, dry skin, or atopic dermatitis?
Patient: No, I don’t have any eczema or dry, itchy skin, and I haven’t had problems like that before.
Have you been swimming in pools, sharing towels, or in close contact with other children who might have similar bumps recently?
Patient: I haven’t been swimming in pools, but I do go to daycare, and my mom says another child there had similar bumps recently. We haven’t shared towels with anyone outside our family.
[DDX] Molluscum contagiosum, Verruca vulgaris (common warts), Folliculitis, Keratosis pilaris, Flat warts (verruca plana)
